message.content: According to the conversation, Yuriko did not explicitly ask Li Hua for help with her studio's homepage before booking a seat at the "Central Perk" café. The first mention of her needing help comes during their third meeting on March 11th, when she asks Li Hua to test the new feature for automatically scheduling available time on the studio homepage. Prior to this, Yuriko had already booked a seat at the café for their initial meeting on February 25th. This suggests that while she expressed interest in discussing her homepage improvements, she did not seek Li Hua's assistance until after they had planned their meeting at the café.
